_comment: Catalog of mesh command types (proprietary range 128-255): the meaning of each type for display/labelling. The authoritative set a given relay can run comes from the relay itself (its [commands.commands]); use 'discover' to query it. 'params' describe an optional command payload (reserved for future parameterised commands).

commands.name: reboot
commands.description: Reboot the relay (re-opens the boot-time WiFi access window).

commands.name: list-commands
commands.description: Report the command types this relay has configured (mesh discovery).
